question: The World Bank has tied with which bank to enable secondary bond trading recorded on Blockchain?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Commonwealth Bank of Australia**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The World Bank has tied with the **Commonwealth Bank of Australia** to enable secondary bond trading recorded on Blockchain.
 
• This initiative aims to leverage Blockchain technology to enhance the transparency and efficiency of bond trading.
 
• Blockchain technology can provide a secure, immutable ledger for recording transactions, ensuring data integrity and reducing the potential for fraud.
 
• This collaboration marks a significant step in the integration of advanced technologies within the financial sector.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **The World Bank** has been at the forefront of adopting innovative technologies to improve financial systems globally.
 
• The **Commonwealth Bank of Australia** is one of the leading financial institutions in Australia, known for its commitment to technological advancements and innovation.
 
• Blockchain technology is increasingly being adopted in various sectors for its ability to provide decentralized, transparent, and secure transaction records.
 
• This initiative is expected to pave the way for future collaborations and advancements in the use of Blockchain in financial markets.
